findings.finding: The bundle allowlist omits transitive imports used by bundled modules, including kernel/capability.py, kernel/types.py, and runtime/task_package.py. With PYTHONPATH set to the bundle, the supervisor appears unable to import from its own bundle and start. The installer test mocks activation and writes a synthetic health identity, so it does not establish live startup.

_copy_source rejects a symlink at the final file path but does not reject symlinked ancestors. A member such as source_root/ops/... can resolve outside the selected reviewed source root and be copied into the bundle.

RuntimePaths validates the root directory but not containment of derived paths. Symlinked ancestors under runtime_root can redirect _ensure_request_key to read or create the private request key outside the selected runtime root.
